A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with complete main text and Appendices A–G. The text, equations and all 19 figures support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original SIM experiments with neural networks in Section 3 and diffusion-model experiments in Section 5, with additional empirical results in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original SIM and diffusion-model experiments, including the additional empirical results in Appendices B, E and F.

M1.justification: The SIM formulation, training loss, linear/ReLU models and conditional diffusion architecture are unchanged. No algorithmic component or training procedure is added or revised.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Gaussian-mixture SIM tasks and synthetic color/size image-generation task, including hierarchical OOD test points and truncated-distribution tests in the appendices.

E2.justification: The linear/ReLU and shallow/deeper model comparisons in Section 3 and Appendix F are unchanged. No evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Experimental settings remain identical, including 5,000 samples per SIM cluster, the reported 40-epoch SGD training protocol, and 20,000 diffusion training steps. Preprocessing, model configurations and evaluation metrics are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the same signal-strength, diversity and architecture analyses, multiple-descent examples, failure case, OOD-separation checks and training-versus-test trajectories in Sections 3–4 and Appendices E–F.

E5.justification: Appendix G.3 still reports averaging over 32 generated images and five model seeds. Appendix E.1 retains the disclosure of initialization-seed tuning for multiple-descent examples; statistical reporting is otherwise unchanged.

E6.justification: The corresponding SIM and diffusion plots, numerical values and qualitative findings are unchanged. This includes the multiple-descent and failure-case results and the 100% held-out classifier accuracy reported in Appendix G.3.

T1.justification: Theorem 4.1, Appendix C derivations, and Appendix D assumptions, lemmas and proofs are unchanged. Minor equation-spacing and cross-reference edits do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: SIM as an abstraction of concept space, a mechanism explaining Swing-by Dynamics, and empirical confirmation with diffusion models.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations, one-layer theory limitations, OOD requirements, initialization-related failure conditions and future directions remain unchanged in Section 4 and Appendix E.

D1.justification: Appendices F–G retain identical data-generation instructions, hyperparameters, architecture descriptions, diffusion schedules and evaluation details. No code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: The bibliography and Appendix A related-work discussion are unchanged, including positioning relative to prior concept-space studies and deep-linear-network analyses.

P1.justification: Sixteen appendix cross-references change from 'App.' to 'Sec.' while retaining their destinations. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; section organization and substantive prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: There are small typesetting differences, including equation spacing on page 22 and the updated first-page margin stamp. All 19 figures retain their graphics, axes, legends, caption content and placement.

improvement.justification: v3 preserves the same scientific arguments, empirical evidence, limitations and reproducibility information throughout the main text and appendices. The cross-reference and minor typesetting changes do not materially improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
